info.title: Next.js API (Feature Requests, Profiles, Personas, Contentstack)
info.description: API for authentication (Supabase), feature requests (with comments/votes and file uploads), user profiles & personas, Contentstack publishing helpers, and internal log ingestion.

tags.name: Feature Requests
tags.description: Feature request CRUD, comments, and voting

tags.name: Profiles
tags.description: User profile and admin user management

post.summary: Log in with email and password (Supabase)
post.description: Authenticates a user via Supabase `signInWithPassword` and returns session + user on success.

post.summary: Sign up with email and password (Supabase)
post.description: Creates a Supabase Auth user via `signUp`.

get.description: Returns `{ user: <SupabaseUser|null> }`. Always responds with 200; unauthenticated users get `user: null`.

post.description: Always returns a generic 200 response to avoid email enumeration. Implements basic rate limiting per IP/email.

post.summary: Fetch OG image (thumbnail) for a URL
post.description: Fetches a target page, extracts OpenGraph/Twitter image metadata, downloads the image, and returns it base64-encoded. Falls back to a default placeholder if fetch fails.

500.description: Failed to fetch preview image and default image.

post.summary: Create & publish a Demo Instruction entry
post.description: Creates a `demo_instruction` entry in Contentstack, publishes it, updates a library entry, and republishes the library entry. Requires `PUBLISH_DEMO_INSTRUCTIONS` permission.

post.summary: Update & publish a Demo Instruction entry
post.description: Updates an existing `demo_instruction` entry in Contentstack and republishes it. Requires `PUBLISH_DEMO_INSTRUCTIONS` permission.

400.description: Missing UID, title, or HTML (or invalid input).

get.description: Returns all feature requests ordered by most recent first, enriched with signed URLs for any uploaded files. Requires `VIEW_CONTENT` permission.

post.summary: Create a feature request (with optional attachment)
post.description: Creates a feature request. Accepts `multipart/form-data` with `title`, optional `content`, and optional `file`. Requires `PUBLISH_FEATURE_REQUESTS` permission.

400.description: Validation error (missing title / invalid file type).

put.description: Updates title/content/status. If the user lacks `MANAGE_ALL_FEATURE_REQUESTS`, they may only update their own requests. Requires `PUBLISH_FEATURE_REQUESTS` permission.

delete.description: Deletes a feature request. If the user lacks `MANAGE_ALL_FEATURE_REQUESTS`, they may only delete their own requests. Requires `PUBLISH_FEATURE_REQUESTS` permission.

get.summary: List comments for a feature request
get.description: Returns comments for the given feature request ordered by oldest first. Requires `VIEW_CONTENT` permission.

post.summary: Create a comment on a feature request
post.description: Creates a comment for the given feature request. Requires `COMMENT_VOTE_FEATURE_REQUESTS` permission.
Upserts or removes the current user's vote for a feature request and updates the `number_of_votes` aggregate. Requires `COMMENT_VOTE_FEATURE_REQUESTS` permission.

200.description: Vote recorded; updated vote total returned.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's votes as `{ req_id, Upvoted }` rows. Requires `VIEW_CONTENT` permission.

500.description: Database error (returns empty array in implementation).

post.summary: Create a persona and set it active
post.description: Creates a persona owned by the authenticated user and sets it as the user's active persona. Requires `USE_PERSONAS` permission.

delete.description: Deletes a persona owned by the authenticated user. Also clears the active persona if it matches the deleted persona. Requires `USE_PERSONAS` permission.

patch.description: Sets the authenticated user's `active_persona_id`. If `personaId` is null/omitted, clears the active persona. Requires `USE_PERSONAS` permission.

403.description: Persona not found or forbidden, or missing permission.

get.description: Returns user/profile records from the `admin_get_users` RPC. Requires `MANAGE_USERS` permission.
Returns the authenticated user's profile fields, their personas, and the currently active persona (if any).

put.description: Updates `full_name` and `username` for the authenticated user. Returns 204 on success.

delete.description: Deletes the authenticated user's personas, profile row, and auth user. Returns 204 on success.

get.description: Returns a public profile subset (id, username, full_name, avatar_url) and a signed avatar URL if present. Requires authentication via Supabase cookies.

put.summary: Update own profile and/or avatar (Bearer token)
put.description: Updates the authenticated user's profile. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and the path `{id}` must match the token's user id. Accepts `multipart/form-data` for avatar file upload and optional `username` / `full_name` fields.

400.description: Invalid input or invalid file type.

patch.description: Admin-only endpoint to update a user's email (Supabase Auth admin) and/or profile fields. Requires `MANAGE_USERS` permission.

400.description: Invalid JSON body, invalid role, or email update error.

delete.description: Admin-only endpoint to delete a user's profile row, avatar (if any), and Supabase Auth user. Prevents deleting self. Requires `MANAGE_USERS` permission.

put.summary: Update & publish homepage alerts in Contentstack
put.description: Updates the `alerts` field on a Contentstack `homepage` entry and publishes it. Requires `UPLOAD_NOTIFICATIONS` permission.

put.summary: Delete an alert (by sending new alerts array) & publish
put.description: Same as update, but used by UI to 'delete' a notification by sending the updated `alerts` array. Requires `UPLOAD_NOTIFICATIONS` permission.

put.summary: Update & publish custom demos in Contentstack
put.description: Updates the `demos` field on a Contentstack `custom_demos` entry and publishes it. Requires `UPLOAD_DEMO_WEBSITES` permission.

delete.summary: Delete a demo (by sending new demos array) & publish
delete.description: Same as update, but used by UI to 'delete' a demo website by sending the updated `demos` array. Requires `UPLOAD_DEMO_WEBSITES` permission.

put.summary: Update & publish video library in Contentstack
put.description: Updates the `videos` field on a Contentstack `video_library` entry and publishes it. Requires `UPLOAD_VIDEO_LIBRARY` permission.

post.summary: Upload and publish an asset to Contentstack
post.description: Uploads an asset via Contentstack Management API and then publishes it to the `preview` environment. Requires `UPLOAD_ASSET` permission.
Accepts a structured log object and writes it via the server logger. Requires `x-internal-log-secret` header to match `LOG_INGEST_SECRET`.

cookieAuth.name: sb-<project-ref>-auth-token
cookieAuth.description: Supabase SSR session cookie (project-specific name like `sb-<project-ref>-auth-token`).

internalLogSecret.name: x-internal-log-secret
internalLogSecret.description: Shared secret used to authorize internal log ingestion.

SupabaseUser.description: Subset of Supabase Auth user object.

url.description: Website URL to fetch OG image from.

contentType.description: MIME type of the returned image.

imageUrl.description: Resolved OG image URL or local default image path.

isDefault.description: True if the default placeholder image was returned.

file_url.description: Path within the `feature-uploads` Supabase storage bucket.

commentCount.description: Initial comment count for the request.

endpoint.description: API endpoint or page where the log originated.

AdminUser.description: Result row returned by `admin_get_users` RPC (shape depends on database).

ContentstackAssetRef.description: Contentstack asset reference. In update payloads this is often just the asset UID string.
